changes.line: [u0011 | 00:01:00.300-00:01:13.740 | DM] Well, this story has many beginnings most to tell this tale start in the year of joyful rains long ago, when the Fraternity of the Empty Moon a cult of werewolves tried and failed to draw Pandemonium closer to {{town}}.
contextBefore: [u0009 | 00:00:36.030-00:00:49.560 | DM] Four unlikely wanderers met, drawn together by chance and circumstance as dangers not seen for a generation began creeping across the border wild creatures, full of all-consuming hunger, driven by the evil energy of the Abyss.
[u0010 | 00:00:50.970-00:00:58.350 | DM] The storytellers will weave the song of years past into the tale for the song of this year, like all years does not stand alone.
contextAfter: [u0012 | 00:01:15.060-00:01:19.410 | DM] They were defeated by the Dunmari outside Tokra, driven east and forgotten.
[u0013 | 00:01:21.000-00:01:27.540 | DM] Few sing the tale of the fraternity wandering in the wild lands in full, for even among the halflings not all parts of the song are known.

changes.line: [u0035 | 00:05:32.640-00:05:48.060 | DM] How Agata kidnapped Cintra's daughter {{to me}} and kept Cintra prisoner on threat of death of her daughter, and how they learned of all this later than perhaps they would have liked from Cintra's spy {{Croatia could}} skilled in many things, except making decisions in a crisis.
contextBefore: [u0033 | 00:05:13.170-00:05:21.450 | DM] Yet if our heroes were listening, they would know the details, how Agata lured Cintra out of Karawa with dreams of her daughter's illness.
[u0034 | 00:05:22.140-00:05:31.830 | DM] deceived her into removing from Karawa the Heart of Shakun, the artifact that kept the divine protections on the eastern border of Dunmar intact.
contextAfter: [u0036 | 00:05:51.900-00:06:06.660 | DM] Storytellers, though the details are murky do not neglect our heroes at the moment, they confront Agata in the desert south of Karawa the tempo of the song rises for here comes the halfling's moment of glory the killing arrow from point blank range.

[u0037 | 00:06:08.100-00:06:26.760 | DM] With Agata defeated the heart restored all seems safe except our heroes don't know it yet storytellers sing of the Fraternity of the Empty Moon hard at work in Tokra seemingly secure in their anonymity waiting until the time is right for the long prophesied ritual.
